## About

I am the Director of Research and Chief Economist at the [International Growth Centre](https://www.theigc.org/) and a Research Fellow in the Department of Economics at the [London School of Economics](https://www.lse.ac.uk/), within the Economics of Energy &amp; Environment programme. I hold a PhD in Economics from LSE.

My research spans energy, AI, climate change, and growth in the developing world. I have advised governments across Asia and Africa on energy and public finance — including Pakistan, Ethiopia, and Myanmar — and I lead a team of over twenty economists working across the IGC's global portfolio.

<p class="aside-note">Also writing and thinking aloud on <a href="https://bsky.app/profile/timdobermann.bsky.social">Bluesky</a> and <a href="https://x.com/timdobermann">X</a>.</p>
:::
:::

::: {.themes-section}
## Research Themes

::: {.themes-grid}
::: {.theme}
<span class="theme-index">I</span>

### Energy &amp; Power Sector Reform

Power purchase agreements, smart meters, electricity theft, and solar diffusion — with evidence from Pakistan, Ethiopia, Ghana, and Myanmar.
:::

::: {.theme}
<span class="theme-index">II</span>

### AI &amp; the Ladder of Development

How artificial intelligence reshapes structural transformation and the path to prosperity for low- and middle-income economies.
:::

::: {.theme}
<span class="theme-index">III</span>

### Climate Change &amp; Human Capital

Mobility, migration, and the unequal effects of a changing climate — and how education shapes who can adapt.
:::

::: {.theme}
<span class="theme-index">IV</span>

### Public Finance

Customs evasion, tariff design, and subsidy reform, with a focus on Pakistan's fiscal and energy crises.
:::
:::
:::
